comments.author: PulIthEld
comments.body:
i can approve or send back or deny generated assets.  When i send them back I can include a little note on what i want adjusted.  then i can watch the progress as it works through the queue.

I use TripoSG for the 3D generation, Marigold to remove baked lighting as well as I can, and Trellis for texturing.  I just asked claude to set it up for me.

comments.author: EuropeanGent0
comments.body: This is nice, thanks for the details, as well whats your typical generation of a aniamted character roughly? are you happy with the animations. Interested to see how these characters in game looks like as well. thanks for sharing

replies.body:
